access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (T-3447) from the museum's open-access images. A black wool suit of 1902: a black bodice with a cream lace yoke and a tall lace standing collar, the front pouched; a black skirt of several gores, close at the hips and flaring to a wide hem with braid at the foot of each seam; a black coat to the upper thigh with lapels, buttoned below the bust over the front of the bodice. A real garment in colour, French, not American and not of the Glessners.
note: One of the 1904 lady reference set's pictures (data/people_match/reference_sets/lady_1904.json): the cut, and the black, of a day suit of the years.
